mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_category (tenant_id, parent_id, name, description, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM asset_category WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM asset_category WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM asset_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC
SELECT id FROM asset_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_category SET parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM asset_category WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
